lines.t: Verse 1
I was walking through the shadows,
Lost and weary, barely strong.
But YahuShua, You showed me mercy,
And lifted me where I belong.
Chorus
Without You, YahuShua, where would I be?
Without You, I could not breathe.
When I stumble, You still see me—
You’re the ground beneath my feet.
Without You, I would not be.
Verse 2
Every time I fall, You’re near me,
In the silence, You still speak.
Through the storm, Your hand sustains me,
YahuShua, You are my peace.
Chorus
Without You, YahuShua, where would I be?
Without You, I could not see.
When I wander, You still lead me—
YahuShua, You bring me to my knees.
Bridge
You’re the fire that lights my soul,
The breath of life that makes me whole.
Forever faithful, never gone—
YahuShua, You’re my morning song.
Final Chorus
Without You, I am lost and cold,
But in Your love, I’m brave and bold.
Every heartbeat sings to Thee:
Yahushua, You gave life to me.
